about: I build backend systems that are designed to scale, not just work. Backend Software Engineer architecting high-scale Java/Spring Boot microservices and enterprise Generative AI/RAG agent systems for global platforms at Tata Consultancy Services. Slashed API latency by 85% and boosted throughput by +40% in telecom OSS/BSS, backed by 900+ LeetCode problems and Rank 1 in Asia (Alibaba Cloud Low Code Development Contest 2022).

subProjects.title: TCS HOBS – Telecom OSS/BSS Platform
subProjects.summary: High-concurrency multi-tenant OSS/BSS platform powering global telecom giants (Sonatel, Malaysian Telecom, OGN, Vodafone) for mission-critical invoicing, billing, ticketing, and account provisioning.

starDetails.situation: The multi-tenant telecom OSS/BSS core suffered from p99 read bottlenecks caused by heavy cross-database joins on high-volume account records, XML payload serialization overheads from legacy SOAP/JAXB endpoints, and manual ticket SLA tracking.
starDetails.task: Re-engineer the data query layer to scale under peak multi-tenant loads, cut p99 API latencies below 200ms, automate 24-hr ticket SLA breach monitoring, and modernize legacy SOAP services into resilient, stateless REST microservices while guaranteeing 99.9% platform availability.
action: Re-architected cross-database join topologies into a high-performance MongoDB document-store cluster, eliminating multi-table joins on high-volume account records and accelerating data-load throughput.

Engineered Redis-backed distributed caching for high-read endpoints with intelligent eviction, slashing average API response latency from 1000ms to 150ms (85% reduction) and expanding throughput by 40%.

Designed parallel and sequential asynchronous API orchestration pipelines in the account-provisioning layer, reducing backend processing duration by 25% while maintaining 99.9% uptime under high concurrency.

Architected a webhook-driven SLA-breach alerting engine detecting tickets approaching or exceeding a 24-hour SLA window, and led the complete migration of legacy SOAP/JAXB XML services to stateless, annotation-driven Spring Boot REST microservices.

Root-caused and resolved recurring production defects across API serialization, webhook notifications, and vendor integrations by instituting structured JSON logging, health checks, and automated smoke test suites.
starDetails.result: Cut API latency by 85% (1000ms to 150ms), boosted transaction throughput by +40%, accelerated backend provisioning by 25%, sustained 99.9% SLA uptime, and reduced production incidents by 18%, debugging time by 25%, and defect leakage by 20%.

subProjects.title: Microsoft ESS (Employee Self-Service) AI Agent
subProjects.client: Client: Microsoft (Delivered via TCS on Microsoft Internal Tool Stack)
subProjects.summary: Enterprise Generative AI agent solution deployed within Microsoft M365 ecosystem to streamline employee self-service and automate multilingual document extraction.

starDetails.situation: Enterprise employees required contextual in-tenant self-service for payroll, leave balances, hardware requests, and support tickets inside M365 Copilot, while global finance teams faced labor-intensive manual data entry on multilingual Purchase Orders across 6+ languages.
starDetails.task: Architect low-latency Copilot Studio connectors to internal Microsoft APIs, orchestrate autonomous multi-agent handoffs across specialized domains, establish CI/CD quality validation benchmarks, and deliver high-accuracy OCR extraction within a strict 1-day SLA.
action: Engineered production Copilot Studio connectors to Microsoft-internal microservices, surfacing leave balances, ticket statuses, payroll data, and device provisioning directly inside M365 Copilot.

Designed agent-to-agent routing workflows using Azure Logic Apps and .NET Core to seamlessly dispatch and coordinate user requests across specialized sub-agents with automated stakeholder event notifications.

Owned rigorous response-quality validation pipelines, benchmarking agent outputs against ground-truth datasets and prompt guardrails to reliably clear an 80%+ accuracy threshold prior to production release.

Constructed an automated Azure DevOps CI/CD pipeline (Playwright test automation, Azure Key Vault secrets, Application Insights observability) aggregating sub-agent responses and deploying to Copilot Studio.

Delivered multilingual OCR automation using Azure AI Document Intelligence for Purchase Order validation across 6+ languages (Arabic, Japanese, French, Italian & more) with human-in-the-loop verification.
starDetails.result: Slashed manual finance data-entry effort by 78% within a 1-day SLA, and achieved a verified 80%+ accuracy threshold across enterprise Copilot Studio agent releases.

subProjects.title: VR Surgical Simulation Prototype
subProjects.summary: High-fidelity interactive virtual reality surgical simulation prototype engineered for medical procedural training.

starDetails.situation: Medical training procedures required realistic, immersive 3D simulation prototypes capable of replicating surgical mechanics with real-time feedback and sub-20ms interaction latency.
starDetails.task: Architect and deploy an interactive VR surgical prototype in Unity covering environment spatial physics, instrument collision meshes, and tactile user feedback flows.
action: Designed and built a 3D VR surgical simulation prototype in Unity, implementing physics-based instrument interactions, environment collision models, and intuitive surgical workflows.
Conducted iterative user-validation cycles with domain practitioners to minimize latency and optimize tool positioning ergonomics.
starDetails.result: Successfully delivered an interactive prototype meeting all latency and spatial physics benchmarks, validated through hands-on user feedback.
